entries.summary: Logged cast-removal review + explanation to doc §9
entries.detail: Code-review Q&A logged to doc §9: removal of redundant (T) casts in EnhancedDynamoRepository update() and saveIfNotExist() (old lines 275/324, .item((T) item) -> .item(item)). Both methods are generic <S extends T>, so item is already a T; the cast was a redundant no-op upcast and an unchecked cast to a type variable (javac warning). Removal has no runtime/API/compat downside; type safety slightly improved. Review commands: git log/diff 1293c50..b305acc on the file + view of method bodies (lines 248-300, 303-335).
